heading: Visual Hardware & Care FAQ
subtitle: Inspect physical garment details alongside technical specifications.

questions.question: What machine stitch count per inch (SPI) is enforced?
questions.answer: Sewn with 12 stitches per inch using heavy-duty bonded nylon thread to prevent seam bursting.

questions.question: What zipper mechanism is specified?
questions.answer: Custom YKK Excella two-way polished brass zipper with anti-snag interior guard tape.

questions.question: How is the hem reinforced against fraying?
questions.answer: Finished with a 4cm double-turn blind stitch hem reinforced with interior cotton stay tape.

questions.question: What button material is used?
questions.answer: Hand-carved genuine buffalo horn buttons dyed naturally with laser-engraved brand mark.
